value.title: Track upload intent survives registration delays and acknowledgements stay in the common database
value.statement: Upload defaults to enabled with one-time legacy migration and later explicit opt-out. Registration and network failure never clear upload intent or unsent points. Live and durable delivery serialize packets, acknowledge only accepted rowids in the application-owned shared track database. Legacy project jobs retire without opening project databases; common delivery takes no project lease. Pending track badges require enabled upload and confirmed registration for the exact server/UID; unknown or explicitly unregistered devices have no track badge. Transport failure retains known registration, while successful packet acknowledgement removes pending rows.
